newsitem.title: UK: BAe rebounds on hopes for strong results.
newsitem.headline: BAe rebounds on hopes for strong results.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc rebounded sharply by late in the session on Friday amid hopes for a sharp profit increase in next Wednesday's year-end results, dealers and analysts said.
After dropping to a two-month low of 11.44 stg, the stock was up 24p at 12.53-1/2 stg by 1510 GMT. Volume was a modest 2.0 million shares.
BAe is expected to post a 75 percent rise in pre-tax profit after exceptional items to 417 million stg, boosted by strong defence sales and a rising workload for the Airbus passenger jet consortium.
"The expectation is for a large profit increase with activity in the industry picking up," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
BAe was among the top performing UK stocks through 1996 and reached a record 13.00 stg on January 17.
